# V1 Smoke Source

This document exists only to verify the Tirzah V1 local memory workbench flow.

## Purpose

The smoke source should be ingested as a small trusted Markdown document. It should preserve source provenance, create a document tree, expose source chunks for retrieval, and support a follow-up prompt that refers to this document from the same session.

## Retrieval Anchor

The release-candidate smoke phrase is: copper lantern continuity marker.

This phrase is intentionally distinctive so direct retrieval and active-document follow-up checks can find the smoke source without relying on a large existing corpus.

## Review Anchor

The document mentions semantic review, profile backfill, active documents, process runs, and graph inspection so the V1 inspection surfaces can be checked from a small local source.
